description: Prepare a React dashboard for internationalization. The workspace is at /home/ga/workspace/dashboard-app with 3 React components containing hardcoded English strings. Your tasks: (1) Create src/locales/en.json with all user-facing strings organized as nested JSON (e.g., {"header": {"title": "Company Dashboard", "nav": {"home": "Home", ...}}, "login": {...}, "dashboard": {...}}). Extract strings from: buttons, headings, labels, form placeholders, navigation items, error/success messages. DO NOT extract: console.log messages, className values, or variable names. (2) Create src/i18nConfig.js that imports i18next, initReactI18next, and the translation file, then calls i18n.use(initReactI18next).init() with resources and language config. (3) Update src/components/Header.jsx, src/components/LoginForm.jsx, and src/components/Dashboard.jsx to: import {useTranslation} from 'react-i18next', call const {t} = useTranslation() inside component, and replace hardcoded text with {t('key')} calls using appropriate keys from your translation file. For Dashboard's welcome message with userName variable, use interpolation: t('dashboard.welcome', {name: userName}). Save all modified files when done.
